title: 第二十五章 意外收获新的发现第二十六章 S级威胁
content_zh:
在测试过子弹对自身毫无威胁之后，林夜索然无味。
这种没有挑战的感觉虽然很安全，但也...没什么值得期待。
脚下轻踏间，他已经如鬼魅般来到第一人面前。
拳出，似炮弹迸发。
轰——！
对方的半截身子被瞬间轰爆成血雾。
对方的身体素质已经堪比黄海，但身上穿着高科技的防弹避震衣，所以抵抗能力比黄海要强数倍。
不过这在林夜现如今的实力面前，亦不过如豆腐一般。
脚尖一点，再出拳，又是一道身躯炸裂。
然后是第三道、第四道。
整个动作几乎是在瞬息之间完成，没有丝毫迟滞，丝滑得好像吃了两吨巧克力。
还剩最后两个...
林夜脚下轻点，身子继续朝着前方突进。
后方的领队和最后一名队员并未看见林夜，但从雷达上所见队友生命气息瞬间全部消失，早已经吓得肝胆俱裂。
“怪...怪物，这是怪物！”
“白痴，不要喊。”
那领队啐了一口，同时快速拔出一枚高爆手雷，拉开保险扔向同伴，身子则是快速躲避开来。
他很聪明，那怪物速度极快，而且是专门冲着他们来的。
所以他和同伴势必会成为下一个目标，而且队员比他更靠近对方，对方一定会在短短一两秒之后出现在队员身边，这个时候高爆手雷也会爆炸。
到时候必然会伤到对方，自己就可以趁机跑路。

运气好的话甚至还有可能重创对方，让他一个人独揽全部收获。
正兴奋间，队友的身躯陡然炸成一团血雾。
来了！
念头在电光火石间闪过，高爆手雷同时炸开。
轰——！
他则借机躲在一棵大树之后避开冲击波，周围尘烟四起，他的脑袋也被音爆炸得嗡嗡作响。
不过他的脸上却是写满了兴奋之色，大嘴近乎咧到了耳朵根。
成了！
“噎死！”
可下一秒，一道冰冷的声音在他耳边悄然响起。
“手雷好玩吗？”
领队脸上的笑容瞬间一僵，瞳孔紧缩，全身汗毛炸立，整个身体甚至因为过度恐惧而变得僵硬。
他没死？
高爆手雷都没能杀死他？
不对，他会说话？
他是人？
不等他想明白这些问题，一只大手直接扣住了他的脑袋，把他整个人如同死狗一般提了起来。
他终于看清楚了对方的身份。
的确是一个人！
一个看起来样貌很普通的中年人。

这个时候，他的脑海中忽然间想起了一个恐怖的名词——化劲宗师！
刚刚露出这个想法，他就感觉到一股宛若潮水般的恐怖精神力疯狂入侵他的大脑，搜刮着他的记忆。
他特么的还是个精神异能者？
content_en:
After testing that the bullets posed no threat to him, Lin Ye felt bored.
This feeling of being unchallenged, while safe, was also... nothing to look forward to.
As he stepped lightly, he had already arrived in front of the first person like a ghost.
Punch out, like a cannonball bursting out.
boom--!
Half of the opponent's body was instantly exploded into blood mist.
The opponent's physical fitness is already comparable to that of Huang Hai, but he is wearing a high-tech bulletproof shock-absorbing jacket, so his resistance is several times stronger than Huang Hai's.
However, this was nothing more than tofu in front of Lin Ye's current strength.
He tipped his toes, punched again, and his body exploded again.
Then comes the third and fourth lanes.
The entire movement was completed almost instantly, without any lag, and was as smooth as if he had eaten two tons of chocolate.
There are only two left...
Lin Ye stepped lightly and continued to rush forward.
The team leader and the last team member at the rear did not see Lin Ye, but they saw from the radar that all the vitality of their teammates disappeared in an instant, and they were already frightened to death.
"Strange...monster, this is a monster!"
"Idiot, don't shout."
The team leader spat, and at the same time quickly pulled out a high-explosive grenade, opened the safety grenade and threw it towards his companions, while quickly dodging away.
He was very smart, the monster was extremely fast, and it came specifically for them.
Therefore, he and his companions are bound to become the next target, and the team members are closer to the opponent than him. The opponent will definitely appear next to the team members in just one or two seconds, and the high-explosive grenade will also explode at this time.
When the time comes, the opponent will definitely be hurt, and he can take the opportunity to run away.
If you are lucky, you may even inflict heavy damage on the other party, allowing him to reap all the gains alone.
While he was excited, his teammate's body suddenly exploded into a ball of blood mist.
Coming!
Thoughts flashed between lightning and flint, and high-explosive grenades exploded at the same time.
boom--!
He took the opportunity to hide behind a big tree to avoid the shock wave. Dust and smoke were everywhere around him, and his head was buzzing from the sonic explosion.
However, his face was full of excitement, and his big mouth almost reached the base of his ears.
Done!
"Choke to death!"
But the next second, a cold voice quietly sounded in his ears.
"Are grenades fun?"
The smile on the leader's face suddenly froze, his pupils contracted, the hairs on his body stood up, and his whole body even became stiff due to excessive fear.
He's not dead?
High-explosive grenades failed to kill him?
No, he can talk?
Is he human?
Before he could understand these problems, a big hand grabbed his head and lifted him up like a dead dog.
He finally saw the other party's identity clearly.
He is indeed a person!
A middle-aged man who looks very ordinary.
At this time, a terrifying term suddenly came to his mind - Grandmaster Huajin!
As soon as he revealed this idea, he felt a wave of terrifying mental power crazily invading his brain, searching for his memory.
Is he actually a psychic?
